text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon receives a fan letter
apparently
penned by a child.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Would you look at this one, Trainer! It
says, "My
dream is to run like Tachyon!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The kid's not even an Umamusume,
though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A dream, huh? Don't you find that
amusing,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Proclaiming to want the leg power to
rival us
mystical Umamusume, how
ambitious!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it's utterly mad! But, that's what
makes it so
interesting!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All right, I best write a response right
away then,
yes?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To the child with their nigh impossible
dream!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, bring me some paper and a pen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I take her letter to a
postbox.
Unintentionally, I get a quick
glimpse at its
contents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If you desire the leg power of an
Umamusume, research is the key. I am
looking forward to your
future
achievements.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though her handwriting was a bit messy,
the
message she left was clear.
